About HK

An advisory practice that began over coffee — and grew into a consultancy with franchising, brand strategy, operations and compliance under one roof.

What started as informal business advice between friends in Kuwait became a Dubai-headquartered practice working with businesses at every stage of growth — from launching new ventures to supporting established brands.

Our Expertise

Building Brands. Enabling Growth.

From the first licence to an international rollout, HK supports every stage of a business — under one roof.

  1. 01 Franchise Development & Expansion Franchise creation, documentation, brand adaptation and international rollout support. →
  2. 02 Business Setup End-to-end company formation — licensing, documentation, compliance and strategic launch. →
  3. 03 Operational Optimisation Streamlined systems, SOPs and team training for efficiency and scalability. →
  4. 04 Brand Strategy & Expansion Identity design, market positioning, storytelling and digital presence — a brand that speaks and sells. →
  5. 05 Startup Consulting Business planning, strategic guidance and structured development for new ventures. →
